meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划分派给多个子代理并行执行,并留下可查的执行记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已写好多步实施计划,想让代理按计划逐项落地并留痕。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan through parallel subagents and keep a traceable execution log
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a multi-step plan and want agents to execute it with evidence.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 不再自己写代码,而是当调度者:读取 .omo/plans/ 里的工作计划,把每个任务派给并行的子代理执行,自己只维护 .omo/ 状态、工作树和证据记录,直到计划里的顶层复选框全部勾完。
howto.when: 当你说「ulw-execute」,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发;若没有可用计划,会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再执行。

say.text: 用 ulw-execute 跑 .omo/plans 里的计划
say.note: 先读计划,再分派子代理执行
每阶段的工作树推成一个 PR
PR 开启后盯到合并为止

howto.what_en: Claude no longer writes code itself. It acts as an orchestrator: reads a plan under .omo/plans/, delegates every task to parallel subagents, and itself keeps only .omo/ state, worktrees and the evidence ledger, until all top-level checkboxes are done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "ulw-execute" or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans. If no selectable plan exists, it first invokes ulw-plan to create one before executing.

say_en.text: Run the plan under .omo/plans with ulw-execute
say_en.note: Reads the plan, then dispatches subagents
Delivers each phase's worktree as a PR
Watches the PR until it is merged
